checks: jump threshold: drift and impulse at every sigma, and the monthly drift-minus-momentum IC gap
controls: drift residual on volatility and traded value; on 12-1 momentum; on all three; low volatility alone
subperiods: first and second half of the months
size halves: above and below the monthly median traded value
6-1 month window: drift vs plain momentum

US industry (Fama-French 12 from current SEC SIC codes): drift ranked within industry, plain momentum ranked within industry, drift residual on industry dummies, and on industry plus momentum, volatility and traded value
note: Checks fixed before running. Size proxy is log mean traded value in the momentum window for both markets (A-shares have no point-in-time market cap). US universe is the S&P 500 / Nasdaq-100 / Russell 1000 union; A-shares use study A eligibility. Industry uses today's SIC code for every month, a mild look-ahead; A-shares have no industry data.
